top_signals.title: Goldman’s Bid for CLO Manager Highlights Wall Street’s Fee Hunt
top_signals.summary: Larger asset managers including Goldman Sachs Group Inc. have been looking to snap up CLO management businesses as they hunt for lucrative fee streams in the $1 trillion US market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: French Polynesia Multipurpose Vessel to Use Liebherr LS-C 60 Crane
top_signals.summary: The LS-C 60 cylinder-luffing ship crane has been selected for the Mareva Nui II, designed for service in French Polynesia. Its compact footprint and low center of gravity support vessel stability while preserving deck space for both cargo and onboard facilities.
